title: Universal Dark Mode Contrast Auditor — Real-DOM WCAG 2.1 AA Anti-Inversion Scanner

method.fastPath: Real-DOM getComputedStyle ancestor alpha compositing down to the :root --cuba-canvas token (DIR-023 spec section 2.1).
method.truthPath: Real rasterised-pixel sampling: a Playwright screenshot is decoded by sharp, glyph and background pixels are separated using the element’s own declared colour, and the worst pairing present in the crop wins. Escalated for any node whose ancestor chain carries a gradient, background-blend-mode, mix-blend-mode, backdrop-filter or filter, and for any node the fast path flagged.
method.adjudication: A violation requires the fast path to fail AND, where a rasterised sample exists, the truth path to agree. Disagreement is recorded as UNCERTAIN, never silently resolved.
method.colourSpace: Every computed colour is resolved to sRGB bytes by the browser itself through a 1x1 canvas, applying the sRGB transfer exactly once. This deliberately avoids the hand-rolled OKLab matrix behind the documented double-gamma bug in dir017-contrast-triage.mjs, and covers the oklch() Tailwind v4 emits.
method.antiInversion: Both themes are measured with identical maths and no theme-specific heuristics, so a light-on-light or dark-on-dark inversion is caught by the same ratio evaluation.
method.printExemption: INV-4 honoured crawler-side: nodes painted only by ink-conserving printer rules are recorded as exemptions, never as violations.
method.frozenPathsUntouched: INV-1: src/cv-templates/ and backend/services/aiRuntime.js are never opened for write by this audit.

identity.note: The platform Super Admin session carries cross-portal access over Candidate, Recruiter, Enterprise and Admin. No fabricated identity and no ad-hoc DB seed script was used.

authority.routeManifestSource: Derived from src/main.jsx, DashboardMain.jsx, EmployerPortal.jsx, Admin.jsx and ENTERPRISE_TABS (components/cuba/portalNavigation.js).
authority.supersedeRationale: Lead-confirmed (bridge evt_mut8za2a_39efab96): the directive’s literal route list was an illustrative approximation. The real canonical surface is larger and is crawled with zero 404/redirect false-positives, because every route is asserted to have rendered a real surface before its contrast is judged.
